synthesis.essence: Atmospheric Cloud Sky & Tactile Pill Telemetry: porcelain capsule plates over a periwinkle blueprint ground with a single Royal Cobalt turnout switch.
synthesis.oneSentence: Switchyard Lite dispatches coding agents across isolated git worktrees using tactile porcelain capsule controls, a royal cobalt interlocking switch, and a double-framed Kanban control stage.
synthesis.family: constructed — Kuwayama 64×64 parallel turnout switch with 6-unit interlocking gap
synthesis.material: Atmospheric Cloud Ground (#F1F4FB) + Tactile Porcelain Capsule Plates (#FFFFFF) + Frosted Glass Bezel
synthesis.surface: Contract #15 Glass & Light + Tactile Capsule Plates
synthesis.edge: Precision capsule (999px controls, 20px cards, 12px concentric items, 28px double-bezel stage)
synthesis.fieldRecipe: 32px blueprint grid mask + soft sky-periwinkle radial atmosphere
